description: A failure that may succeed on a later attempt: network errors, `408`, `429`, `502`, `503`, `504`.
Wait `base * 2^attempt` between attempts, capped at a maximum, so retries slow down during longer outages.
Random delay between 0 and the backoff value. Spreads retries from many clients and prevents a thundering herd.
Repeating an operation has the same effect as doing it once. Required before retrying writes; idempotency keys make `POST` safe.
Retries at several layers multiply: 3 retries at 3 layers can turn one call into 64.
Stops calling a dependency that keeps failing and fails fast for a cool-down period, then probes again.
Response header on `429` or `503` telling the client how long to wait. Overrides the computed delay.
